name: Auction House Bot
description: Populates the auction house with bot-posted items (~75 items per cycle; full population takes hours).

sql.note: updates.name values: auctionhousebot_professionItems.sql, mod_auctionhousebot.sql (professionItems lacks CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — classic 'Table already exists' if applied twice by hand)

keys.note: account id owning the bot character
keys.label: Bot account id
keys.explain: The account number (in realmd->account table) of the player you want to run as the auction bot.

keys.label: Bot character GUID
keys.explain: The GUID (in characters->characters table) of the player you want to run as the auction bot.

keys.label: Sell items
keys.explain: Enable/Disable the part of AHBot that puts items up for auction.

keys.label: Buy items
keys.explain: Enable/Disable the part of AHBot that buys items from players.

prompts.question: GUID of the AH bot character (create the AHBOT account + ONE character first, log it out)

exists.query: SELECT name FROM characters WHERE guid = {bot_guid}
exists.missing: no character in this server's own database has GUID {bot_guid} — create the AHBOT account and ONE character, log that character out, then try again

prompts.question: Account id of the AH bot character (the AHBOT account you created it on; Yu'lon checks the two name the same character)

exists.query: SELECT name FROM characters WHERE guid = {bot_guid} AND account = {bot_account}
exists.missing: character GUID {bot_guid} does not belong to account {bot_account} in this server's own database — the two keys must name the same character

notes: Configure copies conf/mod_ahbot.conf.dist fresh over the active conf on every run (overwrites prior edits), then sets the keys above; if the worldserver is running the conf is also docker cp'd into the container and a restart is required. wow-manage.sh 2249-2373.
Legacy path <server>/conf/modules/mod_ahbot.conf is migrated to env/dist/etc/modules/ when the new one is missing (6130-6140).
